text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Use  a  lashing  belt and  apply  pressure  to  the  rear  module stack .
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Inspect the module installation condition, and correct it if it is skewed or a large distortion is found.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Install the 2 through-bolts at opposite corners of the module, then insert φ 7 mm (0.28 in) metal bars (A) into the bolt holes and tighten the mounting nuts to the prescribed torque.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: CAUTION: If the collar position is incorrect, there is a risk of the bolts loosening because they are not supported by the collar between the modules.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Install the remaining 2 through-bolts, and tighten the mounting nuts to the prescribed torque.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: When installing, hold the end of the through bolt stationary and tighten the installation nut.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Install the rear stack member .
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear and use insulated tools.

text_elements.text: Install the front stack member .

text_elements.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear and use insulated tools.

text_elements.text: Remove the module terminal cover [SST: KV99111500 ( -)] (A).

text_elements.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Use an insulated torque driver (A) and tighten the voltage detection terminal mounting screws to the prescribed torque.

text_elements.text: DANGER:
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: There  is  the  danger  of  electric  shock  caused  by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: This work must not be performed by multiple opera-
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: tors because there is a risk of electric shock if the operators contact one another.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Tighten the module terminal mounting bolts in numerical order as shown in the figure.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When tightening of 1 - 16 is completed, install the left-side bus bar cover.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When tightening of 17 - 32 is completed, install the right-side bus bar cover.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When tightening of 33 - 48 is completed, install the center bus bar cover.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: DANGER:

text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: This work must not be performed by multiple operators because there is a risk of electric shock if the operators contact one another.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Install the bus bar cover .
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: CAUTION:
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Be sure to reinstall the high voltage harness clips in their original positions. If a clip is damaged, replace it with a new clip before installing.

text_elements.text: Use vinyl tape or similar means (A) for preventing air leakage from the PTC harness connector.

text_elements.text: Use wide vinyl tape that is capable of covering all of the PTC harness connector with one strip.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Apply carefully so that no wrinkles in the tape occur.

text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Follow the procedure below to check the battery case pressure.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Open the cock on the air leak tester.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: CAUTION: Do not operate the pump before opening the cock on the air leak tester. Doing so may damage the gauge. If the pump is operated before the cock is opened, first disconnect the air pump hose to release the pressure.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Operate the air pump slowly and apply the specified inspection pressure inside the battery pack. If the gauge pressure does not rise, or if the gauge reading fluctuates, check for the location of air leakage.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: CAUTION:
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Operate the air pump carefully when applying pressure. If pressure is applied suddenly to the gauge, the gauge may be damaged.

text_elements.text: Do not apply pressure of 2.0 kPa (0.0204 kg/cm 2 ) or more to the battery case or air leak tester.
